says: In next/, the new runs option of StartsTest.law ({ examples, runs }) is a case count that fabrika/runs-from-depth does not read, so a law over real IO that writes StartsTest.law(..., { runs: 100 }) passes lint and breaks decision 0535; only a doc comment says 'never a number'.
proof: runs-from-depth.ts line 359 treats a key as a count only when it is numRuns, or runs inside an arbitrary object (inArbitrary, lines 151-155). StartsTest.ts lines 15-19 at 297895bf9 type runs as a plain number with the doc line 'never a number (decision 0535)', and line 28 hands it to numRuns inside the shared module, which the rule cannot see.
cost: The next real-IO start law can pin its count by hand with no check refusing it, the same gap T753 L16 had until this pull request.
